_readme: Claude Code SessionStart hook for Facto. EASIEST WAY: run `facto connect claude-code` in your project — it writes this for you (and `facto connect --all` also wires MCP + git). The block below is what it produces.
_note_folder_mode: Only if you run Facto from a folder (no pip install): use the OS-specific script command instead. Windows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}\facto\hooks\on-session-start.ps1"  ·  mac/linux: bash "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/facto/hooks/on-session-start.sh"
